name: verify_lock_scope_by_company_field
note: Verifier op (UNT14-39). ResCompany._get_user_lock_date / _get_violated_lock_dates (addons/account/models/company.py) filter exceptions by company, lock date field and user_id in (uid, False): per company and lock date field, global vs user-bound exceptions and the min/max exception lock date, all rows
source_sql: SELECT company_id, lock_date_field, (user_id IS NULL) AS global_scope, count(*) AS n, min(lock_date) AS min_lock_date, max(lock_date) AS max_lock_date, min(company_lock_date) AS min_company_lock_date FROM account_lock_exception GROUP BY company_id, lock_date_field, (user_id IS NULL)

name: verify_audit_columns_by_id
